experiment_data.hypothesis: Phase 2 λ=0 second seed (seed0): two-stage training. Stage 1: fresh SDF training (λ=0.005, 10K steps) to create 10K checkpoint (no existing 10K SDF checkpoint available for seed0/seed1 — intermediate checkpoints from original 30K runs were cleaned). Stage 2: resume from 10K SDF checkpoint with λ=0, train to 30K total. Provides multi-seed validation of Phase 2 safety persistence. Phase 2 seed2 v1 at 20K showed CAR=57.5% (positive signal).
